apiBaseUrl.title: Soter API Base URL
apiBaseUrl.description: The base URL of the Soter Enterprise API server.

organizationId.title: Organization ID
organizationId.description: The unique identifier for the organization in Soter.

employeeId.title: Employee ID
employeeId.description: The unique identifier for the employee within the organization.

email.title: Employee Email
email.description: The corporate email address of the employee.

department.title: Department
department.description: The employee's department within the organization.

role.title: Role
role.description: The employee's role or job function.

deviceToken.title: Device Token
deviceToken.description: Pre-configured device authentication token for the extension.

policyChannel.title: Policy Channel
policyChannel.description: The policy distribution channel (stable, beta, canary).

enrollmentMode.title: Enrollment Mode
enrollmentMode.description: Set to 'managed' to auto-enroll without user interaction.

hardEnforcement.title: Hard Enforcement
hardEnforcement.description: When true, a block decision cannot be dismissed or bypassed by the user.

offlineFailClosed.title: Fail Closed When Offline
offlineFailClosed.description: When true, sensitive data is blocked while the org policy cannot be refreshed from the control plane.

requirePolicySignature.title: Require Signed Policy
requirePolicySignature.description: When true, a policy bundle whose signature cannot be cryptographically verified is refused and the extension fails closed. Requires policyTrustedKeys.

disableNetworkLayerEnforcement.title: Disable Network-Layer Enforcement
disableNetworkLayerEnforcement.description: When true, a block decision is enforced at the page-submit layer only and the short tab-scoped declarativeNetRequest deny window is not installed. Leave false unless an internal AI portal is incompatible with it.

policyTrustedKeys.title: Trusted Policy Signing Keys
policyTrustedKeys.description: Public keys trusted to sign org policy bundles. Base64 SPKI for ECDSA P-256. Private keys must never be placed here.

keyId.title: Key ID
keyId.description: Identifier that matches the signatureKeyId in signed policy bundles.

algorithm.title: Algorithm
algorithm.description: Signature algorithm. ecdsa-p256-sha256 is required for new deployments; hmac-sha256 is legacy only.

publicKey.title: Public Key
publicKey.description: Base64-encoded SPKI public key (ECDSA), or the shared secret for legacy HMAC deployments.
